//: Nothing here ever merges itself. Validate-don't-mutate is deliberate; see CLAUDE.md.

packageRules.//: Action digests are the point of this config. Pinned SHAs never receive upstream fixes on their own, so they need a bot watching them. Highest priority, own PR, never grouped into noise.
pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish holds the PyPI trusted-publishing OIDC exchange. A digest change here is a supply-chain event, not a chore. Never group it with anything.
Zero runtime dependencies is a design property of the server, Fleet and Revenue. Any PR that adds or bumps a production dependency is a design decision and must read as one.
viem stays a devDependency. Runtime crypto is @noble/curves plus @noble/hashes. If this ever appears under dependencies, that is a bug rather than an upgrade.
Dev tooling batches into one weekly PR. Low risk, and the test suite is the gate.

Integration packages track frameworks we do not control. Their real compatibility gate is the real-package CI job, not a version number, so a major bump is a decision for the dashboard rather than an automatic PR.
Node 22 and Python 3.12 are pinned deliberately across every workflow. Moving a runtime is a decision, never a bot PR.
